body:
Measure what task:d41626ab51473623 could only estimate, before building anything.

- Time `cargo check --all-targets --message-format=json` in `solace-cli/`: cold (fresh target folder), warm with no change, and warm after a one-function edit.
- Time `cargo test` warm after the same edit.
- Run `cargo fmt --check`: is the crate rustfmt-clean today?
- Confirm the JSON gives a primary span (file, lines) for a deliberate type error and a borrow error.

The commands are root commands the human approves.

### Done when

A note with the times and findings. If warm `cargo check` is well over the 1–3 s estimate, say what that means for submit.
title: Rust: measure check and test times
